meta.title: Free 3-day MCP trial | GST
meta.description: Issue a 3-day trial credential for the GST MCP server in one click. No email, account or card. Use it from Claude on the web or Claude Desktop, or from a script with OAuth 2.1 client credentials.
title: Try the GST MCP server for 3 days
facts.tools.desc: The sixteen diligence, portfolio and regulatory tools, the reference library and regulation resources, and every gst_ prompt. Radar tools and feeds are excluded.
facts.ceilings.desc: 15 calls per minute, 100 per day. Non-contractual capacity limits, not an SLA.
facts.after.desc: The credentials stop authenticating. Nothing is charged and nothing renews. One trial per network. Signing up again replaces the previous credentials.
flowLabel: Choose how you will use the trial
connFeatures.1: Use the GST tools inside Claude on the web or Claude Desktop
connFeatures.2: One key to paste at the consent page. No code, no config files
connFeatures.3: Works for 72 hours, then the connector simply stops
m2mFeatures.1: For a script, pipeline or agent framework
m2mFeatures.2: OAuth 2.1 client_credentials: exchange the pair for an hourly bearer token
ctaCode: Issue a client ID and secret
onceBodyIdle: After you click, the client secret appears on this page a single time. It cannot be retrieved later. You will need to copy or download it before leaving.
onceBodyIdleC: After you click, the trial key appears on this page a single time. It cannot be retrieved later. You will need to copy or download it before leaving.
onceBodyIssued: This is the only time the client secret will be displayed. Copy it or download the file before you leave this page. If it is lost, the only option is to sign up again, which replaces it.
onceBodyIssuedC: This is the only time the trial key will be displayed. Copy it or download the file before you leave this page. If it is lost, the only option is to sign up again, which replaces it.
verifyBody: Usually under a second. Please keep this page open.
verifyLongBody: This is taking longer than usual. A few more seconds. Please keep this page open.
revokedTitle: Your previous secret has stopped working
revokedBody: You already had a trial on this network. The credentials issued on {date} were revoked the moment these were created. Any client still configured with them will fail to authenticate until you update it.
keyHint: Your client ID and secret joined by a colon, exactly as the consent page expects it. Treat it like a password. GST does not store it in recoverable form.
secretHint: Treat it like a password. It is not stored by GST in recoverable form.
cIntro: Follow the GST MCP connector guide. It walks through adding the custom connector in Claude on the web or Claude Desktop; when the consent page asks for your key, paste the trial key shown above. Keep this tab open until the key is saved.
cEndsTitle: The connection ends with the trial
cEndsBody: The approval you give at the consent page lasts exactly as long as the trial, even if you approve on the last day. Radar tools are refused for trial connections. When the trial ends the connector stops authenticating; remove it from Claude.
cAfterExpiry: Endpoint https://mcp.globalstrategic.tech/mcp. Once the trial ends, approving at the consent page fails and the key is refused.
connectLabel: Use it from a script or pipeline
connectIntro: This is a machine-to-machine credential (OAuth 2.1 client_credentials). It is for code you run: a script, a pipeline, an agent framework. It does not work in the connector settings of Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT; those authenticate a person with an operator-issued key.
step1Title: Exchange the pair for a bearer token
step1Body: POST both values to /token. The response carries an mcp_m2m_ access token valid for one hour.
step2Title: Call the server with the token
step2Body: Send it as Authorization: Bearer on every request to /mcp. Below, a tools/list call as a smoke test.
hourlyBody: There is no refresh token. When a call returns 401, repeat step 01 and continue; a 401 on step 01 itself means the trial has ended. The official MCP SDKs handle this loop for you (ClientCredentialsProvider), so keep the client ID and secret in your secret store, not the token.
afterExpiry: Endpoint https://mcp.globalstrategic.tech/mcp. Once the trial ends, the token exchange and every call return 401. Delete the pair from your secret store.
errBotBody: The invisible bot check did not pass. This happens with some privacy extensions and VPNs. Retrying usually works; if not, try another browser.
errRateTitle: Too many requests from this network
errRateBody: This network has hit the sign-up limit. Wait a moment and try again. No credentials were issued.
errExpiredTitle: This network has already used its trial
errExpiredBody: A 3-day trial was issued to this network on {date} and has expired. Trials cannot be repeated. For continued access, request an evaluation licence. Most are approved within one business day.
errExpiredBodyNoDate: A 3-day trial was already issued to this network and has expired. Trials cannot be repeated. For continued access, request an evaluation licence. Most are approved within one business day.
errUnavailBody: This is on our side, not yours. Nothing was issued. Try again in a minute; if it persists, check the status page.
liveIssuedC: Credentials issued. The trial key is on screen. It is shown only once.
liveIssued: Credentials issued. Client ID and client secret are on screen. The secret is shown only once.
